question: Do Geodd (geodd.io), Heabsy (heabsy.com), HiAPI (hiapi.ai) and Gonka (gonka.ai) have inference records? None is held in any topic.
why: computeprices.com lists all four under G or H; each sells token-metered inference only (no hourly GPU rental), so they are not compute records. Heabsy states 'There is no free tier or trial credit', 'No embeddings endpoint and no GPU rental'; Gonka bills per token in GNK with a wallet and has no hourly price; Geodd and HiAPI list only per-1M-token rates.
